finding.text: Controls keeps its three cards side by side at 400, so each card is about 100px wide. Labels break mid-word ("MESSAG E", "COUNTE RS"), inputs clip ("Jane C", "you@e") and a toggle label runs off its card ("Notifica") (layout 1, wrapping 1). Evidence: shots/framework-ext-Figma-palette-controls/400.png, middle band. Pricing stacks at 400; Controls should do the same.

Color Schemes leaves 77% of the screen empty at 1920 and 86% at 3440. Its white, prime and dark cards stack in one narrow column on the left, when they could sit side by side like the grounds row on /framework/styles/ (sizing, spacing: wasted space). Evidence: layout.json empty 0.774/0.864 and big_empty bands at 1920/3440; shots/framework-ext-Figma-colors/3440.png.

White button text on `--prime` still ships ("CHOOSE PLAN", "SUBMIT", about 2:1). This contradicts the brief's own decision 2, which says ink on prime is dark (colour 1). It comes from the existing `.btn.prim` rule, not this diff, so record it as the next step and don't block on it. Evidence: shots/framework-ext-Figma-palette-pricing/1920.png, card band.

Every Figma page shows its title twice: the page title "Pricing & Dashboard" and, right under it, the frame's own heading "PRICING & DASHBOARD" (page 1). The same happens on Controls. Evidence: shots/framework-ext-Figma-palette-pricing/1920.png, top two bands.
At 3440 the pricing cards stretch to about 830px each, and their buttons stretch with them (sizing). Evidence: shots/framework-ext-Figma-palette-pricing/3440.png.

18 shot pages render "Page Load Error" (edric/style/*, edric/framework/app|view, alex/styles/bem, castin/styles, michael/branding, imagine/paging/templates/theming), and one page is a 404 (/framework/core/new/1/agents/content/). These failures were already there before this diff: edric/style/buttons fails the same way on unmerged michael/dev ("reading 'el'"). The diff only renamed `--prim` → `--prime` strings in them. They fall outside this task.

The card page's first demo is a card about View ("CORE · View · A DOM element…"), so the first thing the reader sees is a different class (content 1). Evidence: shots/framework-ui-card/1200.png, bleed band.

Color Schemes is still a narrow single column at wide screens (layout: use of space), although STATE.md says the "full width" fix landed in `595d46a80`. The cards are about 360px wide at 1200 and about 720px at 3440, so 86% of the 3440 shot is empty: shots/framework-ext-Figma-colors/sheet.png, and layout.json `empty` 0.68 / 0.77 / 0.86 at 1200 / 1920 / 3440.

Buttons on the prime ground still have white text (about 2:1), which breaks decision 2 ("ink on prime is dark") and the contrast rule. Seen on CHOOSE PLAN and SUBMIT: shots/framework-ext-Figma-palette-pricing/1920.png, card band; shots/framework-ext-Figma-palette-controls/1920.png, form cards.

Every Figma page shows its title twice: the page title, then the frame's own uppercase h1 ("Pricing & Dashboard" / "PRICING & DASHBOARD"). At 400 both lines wrap to 2 lines (layout.json wraps, h1.page-title and h1.h1).
At 3440 the pricing cards stretch to about 830px each, with the price and the button far apart. Give them a max width: shots/framework-ext-Figma-palette-pricing/3440.png.

The card's home, /framework/ui/card/, opens with a View card (thick black border), not a plain `.card`. The one card this task defines is not the first thing shown: shots/framework-ui-card/1920.png, top band.
On the Figma tasks and timeline pages, card headings wrap 5 to 8 lines at 400 ("Update release notes…" 8 lines, layout.json). The columns do not drop to one at that width.
The sweep shot 101 pages, many of them outside this task. castin/styles shows "Page Load Error" (h1.h1 wrap at 400), so check that it loads, though it is probably unrelated to this diff.
